correction.recordOnly: Record corrected; no cash exchanged now
correction.settleConfirm: This changes the cash balance by {{amount}} TL. Has cash actually been exchanged?
correction.settleError: Settlement failed. Check your active shift and the transaction status; retry is safe.
correction.closed: This transaction belongs to a closed shift. Closing amounts are preserved.
correction.now: Yes — the calculated cash difference was exchanged now
correction.later: No — record the cash difference as a pending settlement
correction.explanation: An active shift is required. Card/bank and unpaid sale cancellations do not change cash. A zero cash difference creates no pending cash. Process card/bank refunds through the corresponding payment channel.
correction.loadError: Correction information could not be loaded. Retry before proceeding.
correction.snapshot: Counted cash, system cash and variance are values recorded at that time. Later corrections do not change them.
correction.noCashEffect: This transaction has no cash effect
correction.cancelQuestion: Transaction {{id}} will remain in history; stock and payment effects will be corrected according to your choice.

error.tenantrequired: A valid cooperative identity is required.
error.cancelled: Cancelled transactions cannot be changed again.
error.notclosed: This transaction is not part of a closed shift; use ordinary editing.
error.correctionrequired: A correction reason and cash choice are required for a closed-shift transaction.
error.reasonrequired: Provide a reason of at most 500 characters and a cash choice.
error.pendingcorrection: Settle pending cash before another correction.
error.activeshiftrequired: Start a shift before correcting or settling.
